question: What’s the nearest restaurant you encounter en route to Arthur Hoyt Scott Amphitheature, PA from South 6th St. Community Garden, Philadelphia, PA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.153583 39.935532)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.355533 39.902444)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.153583 39.935532)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.153583 39.935532)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: South 6th St. Community Garden, Philadelphia, PA
